title: Studio's Edit mode keeps old module code after a script is changed
observation: A Luau test suite run in Studio's Edit mode (through Studio MCP's execute_luau) kept failing on a bug that had already been fixed and synced into the ModuleScript's Source: require returned the cached result of the old source. Replacing every game and test ModuleScript with a fresh Clone (same name and parent) before requiring made the next run use the new code, and the test passed.
recommendation: Before re-running Edit-mode tests after changing a ModuleScript's Source, replace each changed ModuleScript with a fresh clone (or reopen the place), and treat a failure that matches already-fixed code as a cache symptom first.
applies_when: Running Luau tests or tools from Studio's command bar or Studio MCP in Edit mode
Syncing script sources into Studio without the Rojo plugin
limits: Observed in one Studio version in October 2026 through Studio MCP execute_luau
Play mode starts fresh VMs and was not affected

evidence.detail: GAME_DESIGN.md V11 lessons (2) and the report's section 22: the preset test failed after its fix was synced, then passed once the modules were replaced with clones.
